sources.title: Connect update: demand connections reform
sources.verified_claim: Ofgem states the demand queue is large and contains non-viable and delayed projects, and its Connect work is considering measures to accelerate viable demand connections. Reform activity is not a connection offer or capacity reservation for a sample parcel.

sources.title: Demand connections reform
sources.verified_claim: Ofgem's call for input and response summary describe Curate, Plan and Connect reforms and explicitly say initial views are not final policy decisions. Policy development is not parcel electricity capacity evidence.

sources.title: Strategic energy planning and connections reform in 2026: putting plans into action
sources.verified_claim: Ofgem describes 2026 as a transition year for connection reform and regional/strategic network planning, with enduring plans due later. Direction-setting planning does not establish local headroom at a sample parcel.

sources.title: UKPN Distribution System Operator
sources.verified_claim: UKPN DSO publishes Distribution Future Energy Scenarios to show possible demand and generation pathways to 2050 and support local planning. Scenario outputs are not guaranteed connection capacity.

sources.title: Distribution Network Options Assessment (DNOA)
sources.verified_claim: UKPN's annual DNOA identifies forecast capacity needs and compares reinforcement and flexibility options across London, South East and East of England. Network-option assessment is not a parcel-specific capacity reservation.

sources.title: Data sharing will help London councils fast-track Net Zero plans
sources.verified_claim: UKPN and the GLA describe sharing local-authority decarbonisation plans to inform DFES and network investment. Coordinated planning improves evidence but does not prove electricity availability at the sample parcels.

sources.title: London Power Tunnels
sources.verified_claim: National Grid states London Power Tunnels 2 is due to complete in 2026 and reinforces the capital's high-voltage transmission network. Transmission reinforcement does not by itself establish local distribution connection headroom.

sources.title: Jules Pipe, Deputy Mayor visits New Cross site, part of London Power Tunnels 2 project
sources.verified_claim: National Grid reports LPT2 progress and describes the project as reinforcing and futureproofing London's electricity network. Project progress remains system-level evidence, not exact parcel connection capacity.
